令和8年第1回定例会の会議結果

name: 職員の給料表と特別勤務手当の規定を改める
summary: 職員の給料額や管理職員特別勤務手当の扱いは、条例で定めています。この議案では給料表を改め、特別勤務手当の対象時間帯や額の決め方を変更します。2026年4月1日から施行し、職員の職務の級や号給の切替え方法も定めます。
changes: 行政職・医療職の給料表を改める
管理職員特別勤務手当の対象時間帯の定めを改める
承認を得て規則で定める勤務の手当額を、定める額の150%にする
施行時の職務の級や号給の切替え方法を定める
why: 職員の管理職員特別勤務手当などに関する規定を整えるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Revises employee pay scales and special duty allowance rules
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Taito City Ordinance on Salaries of Employees
en.summary: The ordinance sets employees’ salaries and how special duty allowances for management staff are handled. This bill revises the salary scales and changes the hours covered by the special duty allowance and how its amount is set. It takes effect on April 1, 2026, and also sets out how employees’ job grades and salary steps will be changed over.
changes: Revises the salary scales for administrative and medical staff
Revises the hours covered by the special duty allowance for management staff
Sets the allowance for work prescribed by rule with approval at 150% of the specified amount
Sets out how job grades and salary steps will be changed over when the ordinance takes effect
en.why: The mayor says this is to update provisions concerning special duty allowances for management staff and other matters relating to employees.
